name: io.github.memosr/base-gas-mcp
description: Live Base gas, tx cost in USD, 4-chain comparison and gas history. Paid per call in USDC via x402.

environmentVariables.name: BUYER_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a Base mainnet wallet holding a little USDC. Pays $0.002 to $0.02 per call. Use a separate wallet with small funds.

environmentVariables.name: MAX_USD_PER_CALL
environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single payment above this many USD. Default 0.05.
